title: 2014 yil: 55 xodimli WhatsApp 19 milliard dollarga sotildi

scenes.text: 2014 yilda Facebook 55 xodimli WhatsApp'ni taxminan 19 milliard dollarga sotib olishga kelishdi.
scenes.keywords: small team celebrating in modest office

scenes.text: WhatsApp asoschilaridan biri Brayan Ektonni Facebook 2009 yilda ishga olmagan edi.
scenes.keywords: man reading rejection letter at desk

scenes.text: O'sha yili u Yan Kum bilan WhatsApp ustida ishlay boshladi.
scenes.keywords: two men working late on laptops startup

scenes.text: E'lon paytida WhatsApp'dan oyiga 450 milliondan ortiq kishi foydalanardi.
scenes.keywords: people texting on smartphones around the world

scenes.text: Yopilgan eshik ba'zan kattaroq imkoniyatga yo'l ochadi.
scenes.keywords: door opening to bright light hallway

description: 2014 yil 19 fevralda Facebook 55 xodimli WhatsApp'ni sotib olishini e'lon qildi: bitim qiymati taxminan 19 milliard dollar (16 milliard naqd pul va aksiyalar, qolgani xodimlarga beriladigan cheklangan aksiyalar). Asoschilardan biri Brayan Ektonni Facebook 2009 yilda ishga olmagan edi, o'sha yili u Yan Kum bilan WhatsApp ustida ishlay boshladi. Sizga yopilgan qaysi eshik keyin foyda bo'lib chiqdi?
source: Facebook press release, Facebook to Acquire WhatsApp (19 February 2014: over 450 million people use WhatsApp each month), https://investor.atmeta.com/investor-news/press-release-details/2014/Facebook-to-Acquire-WhatsApp/default.aspx ; SEC exhibit 99.1 press release, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1326801/000132680114000010/exhibit991_pressrelease219.htm ; NPR, Facebook will buy WhatsApp for $19 billion (55 employees), https://www.npr.org/sections/thetwo-way/2014/02/19/279763675/facebook-will-buy-whatsapp-message-service-for-19-billion ; Quartz, Are WhatsApp's 55 employees millionaires now, https://qz.com/179460/are-whatsapps-55-employees-millionaires-now-not-so-fast ; Irish Times, Facebook turned down WhatsApp co-founder for job, https://www.irishtimes.com/business/technology/facebook-turned-down-whatsapp-co-founder-for-job-1.1700017 ; The Next Web, Facebook turned down WhatsApp co-founder Brian Acton for a job in 2009, https://thenextweb.com/news/facebook-turned-whatsapp-co-founder-brian-acton-job-2009
